directories.readme:
# References

Store source materials, reference links, and user-provided materials here.

Treat this directory as read-only by default unless the user explicitly asks you to edit source material.

# Drafts

Store AI-generated drafts, working notes, and intermediate versions here.

Drafts are not the formal source of truth.

# Final Outputs

Store user-approved outputs and confirmed deliverables here.

A project may declare another formal source of truth; by default, this directory holds confirmed outputs.
